U.S. NAVY RATING CWT

CWT Cyber Warfare Technician

ASVAB score requirements, what the job involves, and how to raise the scores that count

Minimum ASVAB score

  • AR + 2MK + GS = 239
  • or
  • VE + AR + MK + MC = 239
  • or
  • CT + MK + VE = 176 and CT = 60

Minimum AFQT

31

What a CWT Does

Cyber Warfare Technicians defend Navy networks and carry out cyberspace operations. They analyze digital systems, find vulnerabilities, and support offensive and defensive missions alongside intelligence teams. It is a highly selective, Top Secret job with long technical training.

Scores That Count for CWT

  • AR + 2MK + GS: Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, General Science. Study: Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, General Science
  • VE + AR + MK + MC: Verbal Expression (Word Knowledge + Paragraph Comprehension), Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, Mechanical Comprehension. Study: Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension, Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, Mechanical Comprehension
  • CT + MK + VE: Mathematics Knowledge, Verbal Expression (Word Knowledge + Paragraph Comprehension). Study: Mathematics Knowledge, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension

Navy line scores are simple sums of standard scores, and each standard score averages 50. A four-section sum of 200 is about average.

Other Requirements

  • Top Secret (SCI) clearance eligibility
  • U.S. citizenship required
  • Cyber Test path for new accessions only
  • Six year obligation
  • Some ways into this job use Cyber Test, which is given separately from the ASVAB.

Related Navy Jobs

  • CTI Cryptologic Technician Interpretive PC + MK = 108 and DLAB 110, or MK + VE = 108 and DLAB 110, or MK + VE = 126
  • CTR Cryptologic Technician Collection MK + PC = 110, or AR + MK + PC = 164, or AR + PC = 110
  • AD Aviation Machinist's Mate VE + MK + AS = 158, or VE + MK + EI = 155
  • AECF Advanced Electronics Computer Field (ET, FC) AR + MK + EI + GS = 222, or AR + 2MK + GS = 226
  • AO Aviation Ordnanceman MK + AS + AO = 131
